correctness.rationale: For a rate-r Poisson reset process with unit deterministic drift and U uniform over the complete elapsed physical history, rescaling z=rt and Y_z=rQ_(z/r) gives a rate-one process on 0<=Y_z<=z. Conditioning on the next infinitesimal interval yields F_s'(z)=(s-1)F_s(z)+z^-1 int_0^z F_s(u)du, F_s(0)=1 and F_s'(0)=s. Differentiation produces zF_s''(z)+[1+(1-s)z]F_s'(z)-sF_s(z)=0. The unique analytic-at-zero solution for s!=1 is M(-s/(1-s),1,-(1-s)z), matching all exact series coefficients. Negative-argument Kummer asymptotics for each fixed real s<1 give F_s(z)~[(1-s)z]^[s/(1-s)]/Gamma(1/(1-s)), so the limiting log-mgf / log z is s/(1-s). For s>1 no-reset paths yield F_s(z)>=exp((s-1)z), and for s=1 monotonicity in s and an unbounded limit as s up-to-1 force Lambda(1)=+infinity. The resulting Lambda is proper, lsc, finite/differentiable on (-infinity,1), and steep at s=1; exponential tightness follows from any fixed s in (0,1) and nonnegativity. Gartner-Ellis gives the LDP for positive y; the lower bound on every open neighborhood containing 0 follows by approximation from positive y, while the closed-set upper bound follows from exponential tightness. Its exact good Legendre rate is (sqrt(y)-1)^2 for y>=0, infinity otherwise. Differentiating the generator at s=0 gives m=gamma+log z+E1(z), and locally uniform Kummer asymptotics in complex s near 0 give second cumulant 2log z+2gamma-2-pi^2/6+o(1) and Gaussian characteristic-function convergence. The proof does not claim a state-space LDP, quenched annealed equality, rates for different reset distributions or memory kernels, or a speed other than log z.
residual_risks: Uniform complex-s Kummer expansion and exponential tightness are standard analytic inputs; bounded numerical tests do not certify them universally.
At s=1 the Kummer parameterization is singular, but the finite-z MGF exists and the required infinite log-scale limit is handled separately.
The rate at y=0 is an LDP boundary value; the theorem does not give a finite-z point probability or a full conditional-on-waits LDP.
Only the unwrapped clock is considered; for a periodic quantum orbit, the physical state alone need not recover Y_z.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge priority attaches to the complete annealed logarithmic-speed LDP for the unwrapped uniform-Poisson operational clock, in particular its positive/zero boundary and both rare-time tails, not to the exact Kummer transform, mean scaling, model or general Gartner-Ellis argument. The 2017 diffusion paper already supplies the same Kummer family with Brownian Fourier symbol Dk^2; the 2026 quantum source explicitly supplies the same unwrapped recursion and energy-basis Kummer solution, with typical log-scale behavior. The 2019 tree paper treats CLTs and local limits for monkey walks. The 2023 Boci-Mailler theorem establishes only a quenched LDP for relocated Markov-process positions and Remark 1.5 explicitly says its annealed upper bound is not proved. The exact characteristic transform plus known hypergeometric asymptotics is a close, fairly direct route to the claimed specialized LDP; this raises a meaningful priority/independent-contribution risk, but in the inspected primary statements the complete annealed rate theorem is not stated or delivered. Searches of semantically similar published mathematical results, primary and scholarly indexing found no earlier explicit full annealed clock theorem. Negative searches do not prove novelty.
residual_risks: The original 2017 and 2026 exact Kummer transforms plus routine Gartner-Ellis are exceptionally close precursors; independent novelty of derived LDP depends on an unstated analytic domain and full annealed tail theorem, not a new model or transform.
A later or hard-to-index annealed special-case theorem (or appendix in older monkey-walk/tree literature) might already imply the rate; negative retrieval is never a priority proof.
Only selected sections of the 2019 tree paper were inspected, and the 2015 fixed-state-reset paper was abstract-only; their full texts were not certified as noncovering.
No claim of independent mathematical discovery, formal Lean verification or human expert certification is made.

value.rationale: An operational time with uniform historical resetting is a natural observable in the established preferential-relocation/quantum-memory protocol. The new explicit rate I(y)=(sqrt(y)-1)^2 for both short and long relative elapsed times gives rare-event probabilities of polynomial order in physical time, not captured by the known typical log-time law or a marginal Brownian-position CLT. The annealed/quenched distinction is a concrete open gap highlighted by Boci-Mailler Remark 1.5; resolving the annealed problem for this exact exponential-run specialization is useful even without a general kernel theorem. The exact mean, variance correction and CLT quantify typical uncertainty and tie rare tails to fluctuations. The value is a bounded natural special-case theorem rather than a new general large-deviation method; routine Kummer and Gartner-Ellis tools do not alone supply its scope and boundary analysis.
residual_risks: The directness of the implication from a previously known exact Kummer formula limits the degree of new structural insight.
Does not solve general annealed monkey-walk LDP or a Hamiltonian-independent quantum state-space LDP; the sharp value is restricted to the natural uniform-memory Poisson model.
